content.text:
The £1,055,293.90 difference is fully accounted for by **which declarations are included** and **six overseas visits whose values OpenInterests leaves blank**.

| | OpenInterests | Exposed |
|---|---:|---:|
| Declarations | 92 | 151 |
| Declared GBP total | £1,268,426.55 | £2,323,720.45 |

**Supported by the data:** OpenInterests’ 92 declaration IDs exactly match Parliament’s feed with `ExcludeExpired=true`. Exposed’s 151 exactly match `ExcludeExpired=false`, which its [importer explicitly requests](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_api/declarations.rs:27). The 59 additional declarations contribute **£889,025.71**. Expired declarations remain historical declared amounts. [Parliament current feed](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests?MemberId=5091&Type=Commons&ExcludeExpired=true&ExpandChildInterests=false&Take=250), [all declarations](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests?MemberId=5091&Type=Commons&ExcludeExpired=false&ExpandChildInterests=false&Take=250).

The remaining **£166,268.19** comes from six visits present on both sites. OpenInterests records their amounts as null; Exposed includes values available in Parliament’s nested donor fields. For example, declaration 13939 contains **£54,921.02** in the [official record](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v1/Interests/13939). Every shared non-null amount agrees exactly.

**£889,025.71 + £166,268.19 = £1,055,293.90.**

Exposed’s all-category total is deliberate: [PR #103](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/103) restores declared amounts across categories after an employment-only regression. These are **declared amounts**, including travel and benefits, so “earnings” would be an inaccurate label.

Confidence in the reconciliation is high. We cannot establish why OpenInterests omits those nested values without its implementation or an explanation from its maintainers. Its [about page](https://openinterests.uk/about) describes overseas visits as frequently lacking monetary values, but that does not explain these six records.

- Source control: 11 PRs, blame and follow-up patches reviewed.
